name: Posting
summary: A terminal-based HTTP client for building and sending HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC requests, with requests stored locally as YAML files.
use_cases: send and test HTTP API requests from the terminal over SSH
import curl commands and export requests as curl
import API collections from OpenAPI, Postman and Bruno
features: work on several requests in tabs
send HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC requests
explore responses with JSON tree and JSONPath

steps: Save each request as a `.posting.yaml` file in a folder inside your collection directory, and put variables in `.env` files there.
Run `posting run -c <collection> <folder> --env <env> --json` to send every request in that folder.
Check the JSON output for each request's URL and the count of passed requests.

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/srv /tmp/coll/http /tmp/coll/gql && cat > /tmp/srv/server.py <<'EOF'
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _send(self, obj):
        b = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)
    def do_GET(self):
        self._send({"path": self.path, "data": {"users": [{"id": 1, "role": "user"}, {"id": 42, "role": "admin"}]}})
    def do_POST(self):
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))) or b"{}")
        self._send({"data": {"user": {"name": "Ada", "id": body.get("variables", {}).get("id")}}, "echo_query": body.get("query")})
HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8765), H).serve_forever()
EOF
cat > /tmp/coll/posting.env <<'EOF'
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=1
API_PATH=/api/v1
EOF
cat > /tmp/coll/dev.env <<'EOF'
PORT=8765
BASE_URL="http://${HOST}:${PORT}${API_PATH}"
EOF
cat > /tmp/coll/http/01-list.posting.yaml <<'EOF'
name: List users
method: GET
url: ${BASE_URL}/users
captures:
  ADMIN_ID: data.users[?(@.role == "admin")].id
EOF
cat > /tmp/coll/http/02-get.posting.yaml <<'EOF'
name: Get admin
method: GET
url: ${BASE_URL}/users/${ADMIN_ID}
EOF
cat > /tmp/coll/gql/01-user.posting.yaml <<'EOF'
name: Get user
kind: graphql
url: ${BASE_URL}/graphql
graphql:
  query: |
    query User($id: ID!) {
      user(id: $id) { name }
    }
  variables: |
    {"id": "7"}
  operation_name: User
EOF

pitfalls.actually_needed: The Linux release archive posting_3.0.0-beta.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz from GitHub releases contains a standalone binary; no Go toolchain needed
Headless testing uses `posting run -c DIR PATH --env NAME --json`, documented in --help and docs/guide/running.md, not in the README
